name: trust
provisional_reason: held-out rows already read by version 1: design version 2 grades rows of split strength-split-v1 (cutoff 2026-01-01) that design version 1 already graded and published (through 2026-04-30), and its changes were chosen after those numbers were read. Its numbers are PROVISIONAL, not fresh held-out accuracy: no marker verdict and no headline accuracy claim is made on them. Fresh held-out rows need a split whose cutoff is after 2026-04-30.
reason_for_new_version: Version 2 is a second look at the same held-out searches, sites and dates that version 1 was scored on, made after the version 1 result was seen, so it is not a fresh held-out test. The data layer was fixed and the panel rebuilt: search volume counts as known only 45 days after its month ends, and intent and etv are null on pages older than their record date. Bug-hunt fixes: marker 2 pairs need labels that differ by more than 10 places, not exactly 10; registration records fetched today are left out, so sd_registration_known is always 0 and is dropped; every scored run must be committed, pushed, clean and scored once. The report now gives the gain over the plain link count, which decides the verdict as the plan says, and prints the stricter gain over the best single measure beside it. Version 1 fed the stricter gain to the verdict. The report is marked a stand-in, because its pairs are sites that already rank in the free panel, not the 20,000 new sites of the plan, so marker 2 can neither pass nor fail on it.
